messages:
Alex M: Quick heads-up — I need to resign. Last day will be 2026-04-09. Sorry for the short notice, can we kick off offboarding and benefits steps?
Jordan (HR): Thanks for letting us know, Alex. We'll get the exit interview set up and start benefits/COBRA paperwork. Benefits coverage will run through 2026-04-30 (end of month). COBRA enrollment window is 60 days from your notice; we'll email the packet. Can you confirm your current home address? :email:
Tess C: I'll own the handover and checklist. @Alex M can you make a short project status doc and pick owners for anything active? Also we'll need a 30-min handoff call.
Alex M: Yep — will post a doc and invite. Also remote laptop return — is shipping ok? Laptop serial RDX-UX12345.
IT Oncall: @Alex M shipping works. We'll generate a prepaid label and schedule pickup. We'll remote-wipe after we receive it and plan SSO deprovision on 2026-04-10 09:00 PST (one day after last day). If you need interim access, request a temporary account. :lock:
People Ops Bot: Offboard checklist created: #8342. Tasks assigned: Tess C (handoff), IT Oncall (assets), Jordan (HR) (benefits), Payroll. Due date 2026-04-15. Link: https://intranet.redwood/offboard/8342
Tess C: I added a 30-min handoff invite for 2026-03-27 10:30. Alex please add the project doc to the invite and drop a short owner list.
Alex M: Done — doc here: https://drive.redwood/notes/alex-offboard. Added owners and next steps. Laptop serial included in the doc.
IT Oncall: Pickup booked for 2026-04-11, 9am-12pm. We'll mark the asset as received and then run the wipe. We'll also revoke any API tokens on 2026-04-10 during deprovisioning. Please rotate any personal tokens before then.
Jordan (HR): Quick questions for benefits paperwork: do you have dependents on the plan? Also confirm preferred email for COBRA packet (we'll also mail hard copy).
Alex M: Yes, spouse is covered. Preferred email alex.m@example.com. Home address is 432 Maple St, Apt 2B, Portland, OR 97205.
Jordan (HR): Thanks — noted. We'll send the COBRA packet to that email and the address within 48 hours. Final payroll: final paycheck will be processed on the next payroll run after 2026-04-09; accrued PTO payout per policy. Payroll will reach out if they need forms.
Tess C: We should also open a hiring requisition for coverage. @recruiting please standby (cc'ing via channel).
Alex M: Anything else I should do before leaving?
People Ops Bot: Quick checklist summary:
- confirm address (done)
- upload handoff doc (done)
- return asset (pickup scheduled)
- schedule exit interview (Jordan to send invite)
- benefits notice sent (Jordan sending)
- payroll notified
Reply 'done' as you complete items.
Alex M: done (handoff doc, address).
IT Oncall: Marking asset pickup scheduled in the checklist.
Jordan (HR): Sending COBRA/email packet now to alex.m@example.com. Exit interview scheduled for 2026-04-02 15:00.
Alex M: Thanks everyone, appreciate the help.
People Ops Bot: All actions logged. If anything changes, reply here or DM People Ops. :white_check_mark:
